basic_info.description: Stately 1906 Greenwich St offers a rare opportunity to create a dream home in coveted Cow Hollow.  This elegant pre-1900 home has been lovingly maintained by the same family for 50 years & boasts abundant Victorian charm (11 foot ceilings & many classic details). A gracious entry opens to a bright front parlor & large formal living room w/wood-burning fireplace & built-ins.  The sunny kitchen adjoins both the dining room & a walk-out deck -- perfect for al fresco dining & bbq'ing.  2 ample bedrooms, a walk-in closet & full bathroom w/jetted tub complete this level.     .  A massive 1,400+  ft full height attic provide huge expansion potential. 1 car garage and much more...!
